rule: snippet_window(text, evidence, max): a window of at most max characters containing the earliest evidence span, placed about a third of the way in, snapped to word boundaries (start at a word start; end right before a space, or at the span end when the span fills the window); a span longer than the window is shown from its start; callers add a visible ellipsis on each trimmed side. Reference: scripts/check_integrity.py snippet_window.
